questions.question: 'Either deck' (SIZE UP and RIG) means your deck or your opponent's deck at two players. Which decks may be picked with three or more players?
readings: (A) P1's deck or the deck of the one opponent P1 selects for the block (MP 2 style); the opponent is chosen before the deck.
(B) Any one deck among all players' decks, picked on resolution with no opponent selection.
(C) P1's deck or each opponent's deck at once ('either' ignored).
questions.recommendation: (A). 'Either' keeps its two-option meaning and the block's opponent selection (MP 2/4) is the established way to resolve a two-player reference. Reachable decks are the same as (B) because P1 picks the opponent; only the choice step differs.

clauses.test3: P1 plays Roulette Wheel of DOOM!: the top card of P1's deck is revealed to P1, P2 and P3. X is its numeric cost. P1 may pick any character (P1's, P2's, P3's) with X life or less and destroy it; otherwise P1 draws 2 cards. P2's and P3's decks are untouched.

P1's Shadowy Mugger enters play and P1 accepts the optional search. The opponent is chosen when the trigger resolves: P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: P1 searches P2's deck for a card and puts it into P2's discard pile; P2's deck is shuffled afterwards and P3's deck is untouched. Choose P3 (second run): P1 searches P3's deck for a card and puts it into P3's discard pile; P3's deck is shuffled afterwards and P2's deck is untouched.

questions.question: Same as MPQ-seed-3 for Sly Bilker: which decks are eligible for 'either deck' with three or more players?
readings: (A) P1's deck or the deck of the opponent P1 selects for the block.
(B) Any one deck among all players' decks.
(C) P1's deck and every opponent's deck.

clauses.test3: P2 attacks as the active player (P1 or P3 is the defender); P1 plays Surprise!. The opponent is chosen before targets (played card / activated ability / flip up): P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: P2's attacking characters are the only legal picks (X is the picked character's numeric cost); P3's characters and P1's own characters are not legal picks. Choose P3 (second run): P3 controls no attacking character, so the cost cannot be paid and the card is refused with P3 chosen; P2's attacking characters cannot be picked either.

P1 controls 2 characters, P2 controls 3, P3 controls 1; P1 activates OUTSMART (pays 3). The opponent is chosen before targets (played card / activated ability / flip up): P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: the 'only if your opponent controls more characters than you' condition is checked against P2: allowed (3 > 2); Underhanded Gamer cannot be blocked this turn. Choose P3 (second run): the 'only if your opponent controls more characters than you' condition is checked against P3: refused (1 < 2). If neither opponent controls more characters than P1 the ability is refused whichever opponent is chosen.

P1 plays Chain Reaction: picks any location, it takes 3 damage and is destroyed, P1 picks any character, it takes 2 damage and is destroyed. The opponent is chosen before targets (played card / activated ability / flip up): P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: P2's faction takes 1 damage and P1 draws a card; P3's faction is unchanged. The location and character may belong to any player independent of the chosen opponent. Choose P3 (second run): P3's faction takes 1 damage and P1 draws a card; P2's faction is unchanged. The location and character may belong to any player independent of the chosen opponent.

With [R][R][R], at the start of P1's turn P1 accepts the optional damage. The opponent is chosen when the trigger resolves: P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: P2's faction takes 1 damage and P3's faction is unchanged. Choose P3 (second run): P3's faction takes 1 damage and P2's faction is unchanged. Nothing fires at the start of P2's or P3's turn.
With [R]x5, at the start of P1's turn P1 may pick any character (P1's, P2's or P3's) and deplete it. Nothing fires at the start of P2's or P3's turn.
With [R]x7, at the start of P1's turn P1 may pick any character (P1's, P2's or P3's) and inflict 2 damage to it. Nothing fires at the start of P2's or P3's turn.

P1 activates CHARGE! (pays 2, destroys Gallant Commander). The opponent is chosen before targets (played card / activated ability / flip up): P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: P2's faction takes 3 damage and P3's faction takes none. Choose P3 (second run): P3's faction takes 3 damage and P2's faction takes none.
Gideon attacks P2: battle damage inflicted to Gideon while it is attacking is reduced to 0; the same applies when attacking P3. Not dependent on the table size.

P1 controls Gideon. The opponent is chosen when the static text starts applying (RQ-mp-5), kept while it applies, and re-chosen if that player is eliminated: P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: when P2's faction loses influence the amount is increased by 1; when P3's faction loses influence, or P1's, the amount is not increased. Choose P3 (second run): when P3's faction loses influence the amount is increased by 1; when P2's faction loses influence, or P1's, the amount is not increased.

P1 controls 2 characters, P2 controls 4, P3 controls 3; P1 plays Mass Confusion (X = 2, pays 2, picks 2 characters). The opponent is chosen before targets (played card / activated ability / flip up): P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: Y = (characters P2 controls) minus 2: Y = 2 damage, divided as P1 wants among the 2 picked characters; P3's character count is ignored. Choose P3 (second run): Y = (characters P3 controls) minus 2: Y = 1 damage, divided as P1 wants among the 2 picked characters; P2's character count is ignored.

P1 plays Noble Sacrifice: picks a character P1 owns and a character the chosen opponent owns. The opponent is chosen before targets (played card / activated ability / flip up): P1 is offered exactly P2 and P3 (no choice when only one opponent is left). Choose P2: the second pick is limited to characters owned by P2 (ownership, not control: a P2-owned character P1 or P3 controls is legal, a P3-owned one is not); both picked characters are destroyed and P1 draws. Choose P3 (second run): the second pick is limited to characters owned by P3 (ownership, not control: a P3-owned character P1 or P2 controls is legal, a P2-owned one is not); both picked characters are destroyed and P1 draws.

Assumes recommendation (A) of MPQ-seed-5. P1 controls Phalludrix. P2 plays an effect that makes P1 discard cards: P1 may put them back into P1's hand. P3's discard effect on P1 does the same. P1 discarding to P1's own effect, or P2 discarding to P3's effect, is not covered.
EQUIP (P1 picks a character; X is 0 for an 'adriel' card, otherwise 3; pays X; attaches). The picked character may be any player's; no opponent choice appears.
The attached character gains 2 strength whoever controls it.

readings.note: turn condition: satisfied by choosing the active player

clauses.test3: Trigger at the start of an opponent's turn (the turn-condition is satisfied by choosing the active player): nothing happens at the start of P1's own turn. At the start of P2's turn it fires with P2 as the opponent: P1 may restore the attached character. At the start of P3's turn it fires the same way with P3 as the opponent. It fires once per opponent turn, not once per opponent.

questions.question: 'If an effect controlled by your opponent causes you to discard...' is a replacement. Is the opponent chosen when the replacement applies (the discard happens) or when Phalludrix starts applying?
readings: (A) Chosen when the replacement applies: the effect's controller, if an opponent, is the block's opponent, so any opponent's discard effect is replaced.
(B) Chosen when Phalludrix (or its equipped host) starts applying (RQ-mp-5); only the chosen opponent's effects are replaced.
questions.recommendation: (A). RQ-mp-5 covers lasting text; a replacement fires per event like a trigger, and (A) matches the recommendation for the other 'if your opponent ...' events (MPQ-seed-2).

questions.question: 'If a character enters play under your opponent's control' is a persistent trigger. Which opponent's characters does it hit?
readings: (A) Characters entering under any opponent's control; the controller of the entering character is the block's opponent.
(B) Only the opponent chosen when Watchtower enters play (RQ-mp-5).
questions.recommendation: (A), same as MPQ-seed-2 (an opponent-triggered condition is satisfied by choosing the acting player).
